About Thyroid Disorders in Bhiwandi

Thyroid disorders affect hormone production and may influence metabolism, energy, mood, heart rhythm, and weight. At Alexis Hospital, Bhiwandi, we provide medically guided Thyroid Treatment in Bhiwandi with careful evaluation and follow-up for conditions such as hypothyroidism and hyperthyroidism. Patients often need Thyroid function testing, medication review, and regular monitoring to maintain balance and prevent symptoms from worsening. Dr Ganesh Ahire, M.B.B.S., M.D. (Medicine), supports patients seeking a trusted Thyroid Doctor in Bhiwandi for personalised endocrine care.

Common Thyroid Symptoms

Unexplained fatigue
Weight gain or weight loss
Cold intolerance or heat intolerance
Dry skin or hair thinning
Irregular heartbeat or palpitations
Anxiety, mood changes, or poor concentration

When to Consult a Doctor

  • Persistent fatigue, weight changes, or low energy
  • Swelling in the neck or visible thyroid enlargement
  • Palpitations, anxiety, or tremors
  • Sensitivity to cold or heat not explained by the weather
  • Irregular periods or menstrual cycle changes
  • Need for thyroid evaluation and long-term hormone monitoring
